Container.Name: media-review
Container.Overview: Friends who use your Plex server Downvote movies and shows they think should go. When enough of the people who have actually tried a title agree, it goes to the Review Queue, and you decide Keep or Remove. Nothing is removed automatically. Set Network Type to the same custom network as Plex and Tautulli. After it starts, open the web UI and enter the one-time setup code from this container's log (Docker → media-review → Logs); then sign in with Plex and add Tautulli, Radarr and Sonarr under Settings. Built on the linuxserver.io Alpine base image (PUID/PGID/UMASK/TZ).

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Web app and API port (Media Ops uses 8484)

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The database: every Downvote, decision and setting. Keep it on the cache pool (an exclusive appdata share, or /mnt/cache/appdata/media-review): SQLite is unreliable through /mnt/user's FUSE layer otherwise.

Config.Name: Sync every (minutes)
Config.Description: How often to read Plex libraries and Tautulli play history

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as
